qualification.sourceReferenceKeys: Original authorized ItemID strings are never normalized or restricted by enrichment. Empty, over-50 UTF-16-unit, NUL or malformed-surrogate reference keys yield all-null unavailable metadata; mixed projections bind those keys as SQL NULL without changing ordinals or cardinality guards.
qualification.originalRowBinding: Original authorized rows with empty, malformed/NUL/surrogate/over-50-unit LineId or duplicate exact LineIds preserve every base row and receive null optional context before reference lookup. These malformed/duplicate cases are synthetic robustness coverage, not claims of production occurrences. Paged absent/null context bypasses supplement synthesis/revalidation. Supplied contexts retain strict schema and exact document/branch/page/identity/count binding checks; unsafe or duplicate original row bindings cannot carry supplied context. R1 ItemID unknown metadata behavior is retained for qualified original row bindings.
